description: Create a new dataset in a project. Loadster treats every row as data and addresses columns by zero-based index — a header row would be fed to bots like any other row, so don't add one when authoring values. Unless the user explicitly asked for a dataset, confirm with them before creating one.

dataset.description: The dataset name and table of values (data rows only — no header row).

tags.description: Tag names; a name the team doesn't have yet becomes a new tag. Omit for no tags.
